programme.title: Love of a Forgotten Century

programme.title: The Lost Pharaoh The Search For Akhenaten

programme.title: Firewords Louky Bersianik Jovette Marchessault Nicole Brossa
programme.desc: Firewords offers an intimate glimpse of three respected, controversial Québec writers.Louky Bersianik, Jovette Marchessault and Nicole Brossard have contributed greatly to the creation of a distinctive women's literature.

programme.title: The Way It Is
programme.desc: "The Way It Is" explores divorce's effects on a family, centered on twelve-year-old Helen. Her journey to acceptance offers insights for all ages, suitable for family-life courses, single-parent groups, and counseling.

programme.title: Return To Vimy
programme.desc: Colourized archive footage that takes us back in time to revisit the daily lives of the soldiers of the Canadian Corps, witnessing the long and detailed preparation that lead to this legendary battle.

programme.title: Best Time Of My Life Portraits Of Women In Mid-Life, The
programme.desc: An upbeat, positive film about a group of women dealing with mid-life and menopause. The women come from a wide range of backgrounds, careers and lifestyles, it effectively dispels popular myths and fears about life during and after menopause.

programme.title: Some American Feminists
programme.desc: A series of interviews, interspersed with newsreel footage, places the American feminist movement in a historical perspective. Six of the women who gave impetus to the movement discuss those issues that most concern them and which are still being debated.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: In the second round of qualifying, ninjas including Jesse "Flex" Labreck, Abel Gonzalez, Jamie "Captain NBC" Rahn and Daniel Gil face up to six challenging obstacles, including Ring Chaser and Rib Run, which are new to the course this year.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: In the third round of qualifying, ninjas including Jessie Graff, Najee Richardson, Michelle Warnky and Adam Rayl face up to six challenging obstacles, including the high-flying Beehive, which is new to the course this year.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: In the final round of qualifying, ninjas including Meagan Martin, Joe Moravsky, Tiana Webberley, Michael Torres and the Cowboy Ninja Lance Pekus face up to six challenging obstacles, including Off the Hook, Spinning Bridge and the new Sideways.

programme.title: Bloomberg: The China Show
programme.desc: From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors insight into the world's second-biggest economy, delivering in-depth discussions with newsmakers.

programme.title: Insight with Haslinda Amin
programme.desc: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day.

programme.title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa

programme.title: Bloomberg Daybreak: Europe
